capabilities.rationale: Local-sandbox registration, email verification, sign-in, session restoration and sign-out form a complete P1 account loop through the generated SiteBackend integration.
The clone exposes only the anonymous recovery entry label and never creates a recovery challenge.
Registration verification uses the runtime-declared local-outbox simulation only; no external email is sent.
The P0 journey stops at review and intentionally creates no order record.
An anonymous, non-submitting order review with server-authoritative totals is in scope.
Payment submission is explicitly out of scope; the review CTA produces no payment effect.
The isolated site database persists anonymous cart and favorite state for the local clone.
